visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young girl with pigtails and bangs, wearing a white dress with bunny and floral patterns. She looks curiously at the camera while a blurred adult female with blonde-gray hair sits in the background of an indoor domestic setting. (2) The girl is then shown sitting at a desk, focused on a white computer mouse. She moves it around with her right hand while looking up at the screen or camera with a serious, concentrated expression. (3) An adult's hands enter the frame to gently move the child's hands away from the mouse. The girl smiles broadly, showing her teeth, and giggles. (4) The girl becomes distracted, looking up and away while poking her finger into her mouth, specifically touching her teeth. She seems to be watching her own reflection on the recording device. (5) The girl starts to crawl under the table, moving out of the main shot. The camera pans down slightly to follow her movement as she disappears into the legroom area. (6) The video ends with a pink graphic screen featuring a cartoon illustration of the girl and decorative text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Whimsical piano music with glockenspiel accents starts. A young child makes excited vocalizations while an adult female speaks with a warm, rising pitch. (2) Rapid mechanical clicks of a computer mouse are heard as the child interacts with the device. The child's breathing and small vocal grunts of concentration are audible over the steady BGM. (3) A cartoonish 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition. The adult voice becomes mock-stern but friendly, using a playful tone to correct the child's behavior. (4) The child begins rhythmic 'bababa' chanting with a cheerful, high-pitched contour. The music continues with a bouncy, comedic feel. (5) As the child touches her teeth, her vocal tone becomes inquisitive. The adult responds with a laughing, conversational tone, commenting on the child's self-observation. (6) A descending 'whoosh' sound effect plays as the child crawls away, followed by the adult's playful goodbye. The audio concludes with a short, melodic brand jingle.
